header.title: Team members
header.subtitle: Everyone who can sign in to your admin dashboard — their roles, login details and pending invites.

search.placeholder: Search by name, email or username

hint.members: Click a row to see and edit details
hint.invites: Click a row to edit the invite

emptyState.title: No team members found
emptyState.body: We couldn't find any team members matching your current search or filters. Try adjusting them or invite new users.
emptyState.filteredBody: Try a different name or email, or clear the filters to see the whole team.
emptyState.noMembersBody: Invite your first team member — they'll get an email with their login details.
emptyState.invitesBody: Everyone you invited has signed in. New invites show up here until the person signs in for the first time.

error.body: We couldn't load your team. Check your connection and try again.

login.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select and copy it manually

roles.noCustomRoles: Your institute hasn't created any custom roles yet.
roles.customDescription: Custom role — what it can open is set in Settings → Role Display.

descriptions.admin: Full access to every module and setting.
descriptions.teacher: Teaches the batches and subjects you assign.

invite.heading: Invite a team member
invite.subtitle: We'll create their account and email them a username and password.
invite.editSubtitle: Changes apply to this pending invite. Saving sends them a fresh invite email.

details.title: Who are you inviting?
details.description: Name and email are required — their login details go to this email.

roles.title: What will they do?
roles.description: Pick one or more roles — they get everything each role allows. You can change this any time.

batches.title: Which batches will they teach?
batches.description: Pick the batches, then the subjects they teach in each one.

fields.name: Full name
fields.mobileHelp: Saved on their profile so your team can call or message them.

missing.name: Add their name to continue
missing.email: Add a valid email to continue
missing.phone: Fix the mobile number, or leave it empty
missing.batches: Pick at least one batch they will teach
missing.subjects: Pick subjects for every selected batch

invite.teacherNote: Teacher is selected — pick the batches and subjects they teach in step 3.
invite.teacherEditNote: Batch and subject assignments for this teacher stay as they are.

validation.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid email
validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number for the selected country

toast.failed: Couldn't send the invite. Please try again.

sent.heading: Invite sent
sent.title: Invite sent to {{name}}
sent.body: {{firstName}} will get an email at {{email}} with a username and password. The invite stays under Invites until they sign in for the first time.
sent.loginHint: Email not arriving? Share these directly.

member.title: Member details
member.profileHint: Photo, designation and bio are shared — they show wherever {{name}} appears on a course.
member.profileReadOnly: You can view this profile. Editing it needs the profile-edit permission in your role's display settings.

photo.label: Photo
photo.help: JPG or PNG. A square photo works best.

fields.name: Full name
fields.bioPlaceholder: A line or two learners will see on courses {{name}} teaches.

member.accessHint: Roles decide which modules {{name}} can open. Pick as many as they need.
member.rolesLockedWhileDisabled: Access is paused for this member. Enable access to change their roles.
member.viaRoleHelp: Access granted by a role is changed on the role, in Settings → Display Settings.
member.loginHint: Share these only with the member.
member.accessOnHint: {{name}} can sign in to the admin dashboard.
member.accessPausedHint: {{name}} can't sign in until you enable access again.
member.deleteHint: Removes {{name}} from the team. This can't be undone.

toast.saveFailed: Couldn't save the changes. Please try again.
toast.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number for the selected country

confirm.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

disable.title: Disable access for {{name}}?
disable.body: won't be able to sign in until you enable access again. Their courses, content and history stay as they are.

enable.title: Enable access for {{name}}?
enable.body: can sign in again with their existing username and password.

delete.title: Delete {{name}} from the team?
delete.body: is removed from the team and loses access straight away. This can't be undone.
delete.note: Only need to pause access? Disable the account instead — you can turn it back on later.

resend.title: Resend invite to {{name}}?
resend.body: We'll email their login details again to

cancel.title: Cancel {{name}}'s invite?
cancel.body: won't be able to sign in with this invite. You can invite them again later.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.body: Your edits to {{name}}'s details will be lost.
